# Graph Index

## Rules

- Signature: `specd graph index [--force] [--exclude-path <pattern>...] [--config <path> | --path <path>] [--format text|json|toon]`; format defaults text; `--config`/`--path` mutually exclusive.
- `--force` requests full logical reindex: clear indexed contents, reprocess every selected input. Only typed recoverable storage-open failure plus `--force` authorizes SDK storage recreation and one retry; ordinary/non-recoverable open failures never authorize deletion.
- Execute through public `runIsolatedGraphIndex` from `@specd/sdk`. Supply graph storage root, trusted packaged task-module URL, serializable explicit configured/bootstrap context descriptor plus force/excludes, progress callback rendering text only.
- CLI MUST NOT coordinate graph lock, spawn/fork, signals, IPC, termination, or cleanup; code-graph isolated worker owns them. Production always isolated; no `SPECD_GRAPH_INDEX_WORKER` or `SPECD_GRAPH_INDEX_NO_WORKER` behavior. Tests use explicit seams.
- Child CLI task reconstructs equivalent SDK host context from explicit descriptor, preserving config path/bootstrap root; invokes `runIndexProjectGraph(ctx, input)` exactly once. Kernel object identity cannot cross process. No implicit project substitution.
- `runIndexProjectGraph` owns workspace/VCS assembly, metadata materialization, provider lifecycle/recovery, and `IndexProjectGraph`; task MUST NOT duplicate.
- Parent renders typed progress/result/failure. Per-file errors remain successful result; busy, fork, task, protocol, abnormal-exit, signal, provider, and infrastructure failures use system-error path.
- Text summary reports indexed/duration, discovered, documents, skipped, removed, specs, error details, per-workspace breakdown. JSON/TOON output full result unchanged, including documents, phases, rebuild, coverage, workspace, and file-error fields.
- Provider/infrastructure or busy lock failure exits 3; busy message advises retry. Per-file parse/unsupported errors remain `IndexResult.errors`, exit 0.
- Backend schema/derivation repair supported only through `graph index` delegating `runIndexProjectGraph`; CLI never deletes backend files. Text states destructive rebuild and reason; JSON/TOON expose stable rebuild flag/reason.
- `docs/cli/cli-reference.md` `## graph` documents index/search/hotspots/stats/impact signatures, flags, examples, context model. Index docs cover repeatable gitignore `--exclude-path`, merge over `graph.excludePaths`, config/path exclusivity, bootstrap fallback, `graph.excludePaths`, `graph.respectGitignore`, defaults, replacement semantics, negated re-inclusion.

## Constraints

- CLI imports graph platform only through `@specd/sdk`; no direct `@specd/code-graph`.
- No CLI-exposed task-module selection or production no-worker mode.
- Force/excludes cross process as serializable input.
- Graph runtime never renders CLI output or calls host `process.exit()`.
- Non-force and non-recoverable force failures preserve typed open error and storage.
